summary.zh: 用 MinerU 把 PDF、Office 文档和图片解析成 Markdown,扫描件和复杂排版也认得准。
summary.en: Parse PDFs, Office files and images into Markdown with MinerU, accurate even on scans and complex layouts.

description.zh: 把 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel 和图片交给 MinerU(mineru.net)解析成 Markdown:版面分析、OCR、表格和公式识别,扫描件和复杂排版比本地解析强。在「设置 → 能力提供方 → 文档解析」里选它,或在文档详情里「用 MinerU 解析」。文档会上传到 MinerU。
description.en: Parse PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and images into Markdown with MinerU (mineru.net): layout analysis, OCR, tables and formulas — much better than local parsing on scans and complex layouts. Choose it under Settings → Capability providers → Document parsing, or use “Parse with MinerU” on a document. Documents are uploaded to MinerU.

help.zh: OCR 用的语言代码:ch(中英混排)、en、japan、korean……
help.en: OCR language code: ch (Chinese and English), en, japan, korean…

label.en: No (read the text layer when there is one)

label.zh: 是(扫描件、文字层乱码时)

help.zh: 在 mineru.net 的「API 管理」里创建。免费额度每天有页数上限,单个文件最多 200MB、200 页。
help.en: Create one under API management on mineru.net. The free tier has a daily page quota; a file can be up to 200 MB and 200 pages.

description.zh: 把一份文档交给 MinerU 解析成 Markdown(按页标出,表格、公式、插图都保留),结果存成这份文档的一次解析 —— 阅读器、智能体读文档读到的就是它。
description.en: Parse a document into Markdown with MinerU (marked page by page, keeping tables, formulas and images); the result is saved as a parse of that document, which the reader and the agent then read.
The document to parse: PDF, Word, PowerPoint or an image.

description.zh: 原文件名;留空用这份文档自己的名字。
description.en: The original file name; leave empty to use the document's own name.
